This self-paced professional development module introduces prelicensure nursing faculty to using AI chatbots and a question-writing app to develop multiple-choice questions. The readings, videos, and ungraded knowledge checks are the same as the study module, with nonparticipant-specific practice and wrap-up videos.

This open version is separate from the research study. No participant code is required, and knowledge-check responses and progress are not submitted to the researcher.

question: Can I complete the training on my mobile device?
answer: Yes. The module works on mobile devices. Your current card and unfinished knowledge-check answers are remembered in your browser. If you close the page, you can return using the same browser on the same device. Progress does not transfer between devices.

question: Is a desktop or laptop recommended at any point?
answer: For the hands-on activity, a desktop or laptop may be more convenient because you will switch between the question-writing app and an AI chatbot. Both the open module and the app are also usable on mobile devices.

question: What data does this module collect?
answer: This open module does not send knowledge-check answers, training progress, participant identifiers, or research submissions to the researcher. Its current card position and ungraded knowledge-check state are stored locally in your browser. Videos and images are fetched for display. The separate nonparticipant question-writing app may collect limited anonymous aggregate button-use counts, as described on its landing page.

question: Who can see my answers?
answer: Knowledge-check answers are kept in this browser rather than being sent to the study database. People with access to this browser profile may be able to access local information. You can clear the browser's site storage to erase it.

question: Can I keep using the question-writing app?
answer: Yes. The nonparticipant question-writing app remains available without a participant code at https://jin-dissertation.github.io/dissertation-app/np/npindex.html.

question: Can I modify prompts to adapt the tool for my courses?
answer: Yes. The predesigned prompts are starting points. You can edit prompts or add context relevant to your course, topic, clinical specialty, and teaching needs. You are responsible for verifying the accuracy and quality of AI-generated questions.

question: How much should I use it going forward?
answer: Use the app as much or as little as makes sense for your workflow. For example, you can create practice questions, prepare in-class discussion prompts, or draft questions for a knowledge check. No ongoing use is required.
